module: Tile sorting functions of the vehicle selector according to the "Sort by" mode: Name, Value, Years, Weight, Top Speed, Power, Weight/Power, 0-60 mph, 0-100 km/h, Config Type. Each comparator breaks ties by name, placing "Other" last.
notes: The comparators are table.sort style: function (a, b) -> boolean, on tiles or configs (fields Name/name/label, Value, Years, Weight, ...).

Sort direction: Weight, Top Speed, Power, Value, Years are ascending. Weight/Power and the 0-60 mph / 0-100 km/h times are sorted in descending order of the value (from the code: `>`), with missing values being math.huge.
Config Type follows the fixed order Factory, Service, Race, Drift, Rally, Police, Custom, Powerglow, Other...; unknown types come after.
An unknown sortMode (including 'Automatic') falls back to sorting by name.

getSortFunction.desc: Returns the comparator of a sort mode; defaults to sorting by name.

sortMode.desc: Name, Value, Years, Weight, Top Speed, Power, Weight/Power, 0-60 mph, 0-100 km/h or Config Type.

sortTiles.desc: Sorts a list of tiles in place with the mode's comparator.

sortByNameButOtherAlwaysLast.desc: Compares by name (Name, name or label); the item named like the (translated) "Other" label is always placed last.

returns.desc: true if a must come before b.

sortByValue.desc: Compares by price (Value, or its min bound if it is a range), then by name.

returns.desc: true if a must come before b.

sortByYears.desc: Compares by year (Years, or its min bound), then by name; missing year = math.huge.

returns.desc: true if a must come before b.

sortByConfigTypeName.desc: Compares by config type according to the predefined order, then by name.

returns.desc: true if a must come before b.

sortGroup.desc: Sorts the tiles of a group (group.tiles) in place according to the sort mode.
